description: Join us for a postcard writing party in support of Erika Yoney for MN House 4A! We'll supply the postcards, stamps, and snacks, and you bring your voice! Let's connect, write, and help get Erika's message out to voters. Tuesday, May 19 6:30-8 pm Front Room @ First Ave Promo - 1408 1st Ave N, Moo
